title: 错误提示音失去意义
description: 三连哔错误音在游戏暂停时发出有效行走命令也会播放，导致其失去原本的提示意义。
evidence: Triple beep error sound that has lost all its meaning by being played just because the game is paused when a valid walk command is issued.
